summary: Dungeons & Dragons video games centered on Neverwinter: the 1991 AOL graphical MMORPG, BioWare/Obsidian's Neverwinter Nights CRPG line, and Cryptic's later Neverwinter MMO. These are related by setting/brand rather than one continuous story chain.

entries.title: Neverwinter Nights
entries.definitive_edition: Original AOL service; no modern definitive edition

emulation.notes: Original service operation cannot be recreated as a normal retail game without server/community preservation.

primary.why: The 1991 graphical online RPG only shipped for MS-DOS/AOL and the official online world closed in 1997, so the best route is historical preservation rather than a normal modern playthrough.
primary.how_to_play: Treat as an archival entry: study footage, documentation, and preservation attempts; the official AOL service is no longer playable as originally operated.

entries.remaster_caveats: Fan recreations and offline conversions are preservation artifacts, not official definitive releases.

entries.title: Neverwinter Nights
entries.definitive_edition: Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition on Windows

emulation.notes: Use the native Enhanced Edition and official/premium modules as desired.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with Enhanced Edition improvements.

primary.why: Enhanced Edition is the current best route for BioWare's 2002 CRPG/toolset platform, preserving the campaigns/modules while adding modern display, multiplayer, and compatibility support. Windows is the best capture/mod route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition on Windows with official campaigns/expansions and desired premium modules installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Enhanced Edition preserves the original platform/toolset focus; original Diamond/legacy installs remain historical alternatives.

entries.title: Neverwinter Nights 2
entries.definitive_edition: Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition on Windows

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with Enhanced Edition improvements.

primary.why: The 2025 Enhanced Edition includes the base campaign and the Mask of the Betrayer, Storm of Zehir, and Mysteries of Westgate expansions/adventure pack while improving controller support, camera, textures, and modern compatibility. Windows is the best fidelity/capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition on Windows; use the older GOG Complete Edition only for legacy comparison/mod needs.

entries.remaster_caveats: Enhanced Edition is a subtle remaster; legacy Complete Edition may still matter for specific old mod setups, but not for official content completeness.

entries.title: Neverwinter

emulation.notes: Requires the live service; no emulator route applies.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC client output, dependent on live-service state.

primary.why: The Windows PC client is the original and most flexible route for the free-to-play Dungeons & Dragons MMO. Console versions are valid access routes but do not add exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC live-service client from the official Arc/Steam route; remember that live-service content and availability can change.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service content, events, and availability can change; revisit if servers/platform support change.
